title: Keep software updated
summary: Updates often fix known weaknesses as well as ordinary bugs. Install them through the software's trusted update route.
introduction: Updates often fix known weaknesses as well as ordinary bugs. Install them through the software's trusted update route. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Keep software updated

blocks.text: Using the fixed version reduces exposure to that known issue.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Find where a browser shows its update status without downloading random tools.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not install an update from an unexpected message attachment.
For more detail later, use this [Cybersecurity Fundamentals further reading](https://www.cisa.gov/secure-our-world).
